exposure: Glucose status (GDM, mild gestational hyperglycemia, control)
cohort: 569 singleton pregnant women in a Brazilian public referral center
finding: Age ≥ 25 years, prepregnancy BMI ≥ 25 kg/m(2), family history of DM, and multiparity were independent risk factors for HIP, while family history of DM and hypertension were independent risk factors for C-section.
